_README: TASK-AR-365 external notification routing -- LOCAL config template.
Copy this file to agents/project/notifications.local.json (which is GITIGNORED)
and fill in your own secrets. NEVER commit the populated notifications.local.json.
External routing stays DORMANT until: (1) this local config exists with at least
one enabled channel that has its secret filled in, AND (2) an opt-in local runner
injects a real network transport. The console only proposes subscription-rule
edits; it never sends anything itself.
